meta_description: Mulch Gardeners in Leeds offers expert garden maintenance, landscaping and design. Local, reliable service across Moortown and surrounding areas. Call today.
hero_subhead: Expert garden care across Moortown and Leeds. From planting and pruning to complete garden redesigns, we keep your outdoor space looking its best all year round.
services_subhead: From regular maintenance and seasonal pruning to full garden design and landscaping, we handle everything to keep your outdoor space thriving.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting, hedge trimming, and border care. We keep your garden neat and healthy throughout the year, handling seasonal leaf clearance and winter preparation.

services.title: Pruning & Tree Work
services.desc: Expert pruning of trees, shrubs, and climbers to promote growth and shape. Safe, insured felling and removal of dead or unwanted timber.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space and budget. We handle patio laying, raised beds, water features, and hard landscaping to transform your outdoor area.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Aeration, scarification, and overseeding to restore tired lawns. We treat moss and weeds naturally and establish new lawns from scratch with quality seed or turf.

services.title: Mulching & Planting
services.desc: Professional mulching to suppress weeds, retain moisture, and improve soil health. Expert planting of perennials, shrubs, and seasonal bedding to enhance colour and structure.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Complete clearance of overgrown gardens, removal of old plants and debris, and disposal of green waste. We work carefully to preserve existing features you want to keep.

about_pullquote: A well-maintained garden is a joy. That's what we build.
about_para_1: Mulch Gardeners was founded on a simple belief: every garden deserves expert care and attention, regardless of size or condition. Based in Moortown, Leeds, we've spent nearly two decades transforming gardens across the city — from tidy suburban plots to ambitious landscaping projects. Our founder started the business after seeing too many beautiful gardens neglected or mismanaged. Today, we're proud to maintain over 850 gardens and counting.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, honest pricing, and genuine expertise. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or oversell unnecessary work — we listen to what you want your garden to be, then deliver it. Customers come back year after year because we're local, we show up on time, and we care about the result as much as you do.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our garden completely overgrown after two years of neglect. Mulch came and cleared it all, then designed a lovely new layout with raised beds and seating area. They've been maintaining it ever since and it looks brilliant. Really competitive pricing too.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been using Mulch for spring and autumn maintenance for about four years now. Reliable, friendly team, always tidy and they actually know what they're doing with plants. Far better than the national chain service we used before.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: Needed a dead oak tree removed safely near the house. The team made it look easy, cleaned up all the mess, and even ground out the stump. Fair quote, quick work, professional throughout. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: James P.

address_sub: Based in Moortown, serving all of Leeds and surrounding areas
emergency_banner_text: Need urgent garden work or tree removal? We'll fit you in quickly and give honest advice. Ring us now —
footer_description: Mulch Gardeners: professional garden maintenance, design and landscaping across Leeds. Reliable, expert, local.
